review_context: Fresh delegated review of S2 source and relevant source contracts; no implementation or specification edits, benchmarks or kernel design.

findings.assessment: Independent enumeration of all 78 unordered column pairs reproduces 10 constant, 33 one-argument, 23 two-argument and 12 three-argument entries. N(d) counts dense per-table tensor bases under the expressly stated lack of cross-table sharing. These are continuous-shape functions; no claim of 78 scalar closure is made.

findings.claim: Storage accounting and necessary versus sufficient conditions
findings.assessment: Degree 0 through 3 bytes and remainders are exact. The degree-3 raw subtotal leaves 16 B, insufficient even for the separately known 40 B five-shape record under this storage scheme. The statement explicitly limits this exclusion to its dense binary64 scheme. 8*N(d)+M_other<=10240 is only a necessary feasibility condition without a complete layout/live-path proof. Endpoint transport, priors, transaction state, errors, stack/ISR and update state are explicitly additional.

624+72+40+32=768 B agrees with the preserved fixed-public-shape specification; 112*113/2*8=50624 B for the H7 factor. The text correctly avoids adding the overlapping 768 B subtotal wholesale to the proposed table.

10*366 days is 316224000 seconds. The 35 Hz and 100 Hz counts require 34 and 35 unsigned bits, respectively; an additional initial endpoint does not change either width. Logical sample identifiers are correctly separated from boot identity, operation/generation/retry counts and lifetime-risk accounting. The 64-bit choice is accepted only for the bounded rates/horizon described; maximum admitted target rate remains an obligation.

The rate ceilings are necessary amortized conditions under a fixed CPU service allocation. At 35 Hz the displayed 457143 is an approximation; the explicit round-down instruction yields 457142 for a hard integer ceiling at rho=1. A8 service curves, blackouts, arrival/backlog and deadlines are preserved as separate obligations, and nominal 16 MHz is not claimed as guaranteed useful service.

README and resolution.json retain all-in 10240 B, 16 MHz nominal, 35 Hz nominal, 316224000 second horizon, 64-bit logical counters, unresolved maximum rate and CPU share, and open B_PLATFORM/B_REPRESENTATION qualification. Selection of a candidate family is not presented as memory, accuracy or deployment acceptance.

independent_arithmetic.method: Python integer arithmetic and unordered-pair dependency-union enumeration; no source implementation imported

acceptance_conditions: A0 stationary exact-input, fixed-reference-temperature, linear-OCV and public fixed-weight premises remain in force.
Tensor counts apply only to the stated complete per-entry degree-d tensor bases without further compression or sharing.
Complete SRAM acceptance still requires a concrete layout, verified live storage/stack/interrupt bounds and all update/transport/error metadata.
Timing acceptance still requires frozen maximum rate, useful service allocation, arrival/backlog and deadline bounds; no target timing was measured.
Counter safety is conditional on bounded admitted operations, nonwrapping implementation and reset/rollover policy.
No approximation accuracy, PSD preservation, recurrence closure, useful-query availability or ten-year physical/numerical validity is established.
